delete.description: Any account type except admin. Erases the account and everything tied to it in one transaction (LGPD art. 18, VI): the user, the dependent or psychologist data, the triage and its answers, the consents, the nickname history and the sessions. The audit trail is not erased: it keeps ids only. Requires the current password. Afterwards every token of the account stops working and the e-mail is free to register again. Cannot be undone. The password is checked against the same per-account attempt budget as login

get.description: Data of the logged-in user, for the front to pick the first screen after login. The user comes from the token, never from the request. put.description: Any account type. Needs the current password. Ends every session of the user (the access tokens issued so far and all refresh tokens stop working) and starts a new one for this request: the new access token comes in the body and the new refresh token in the HttpOnly cookie, as in the login. Wrong current passwords count against the same per-e-mail budget as the login (10 failures per 15 minutes). The new password follows the registration rule and must differ from the current one
